## Problem and behavior

Describe the concrete analysis problem and resulting behavior. State the target scope and distinguish current implementation from plans.

## Side effects and data

List added or changed hooks, writes, permissions, handlers, background tasks, defaults, output paths and data exposure. State none when applicable. Do not include sensitive evidence in a public PR.

## Validation

Record the commit/toolchain/configuration and relevant passed, failed, skipped or unexecuted checks. Link owned-fixture evidence and known limitations.

## Dependencies and documentation

Identify dependency/source/license changes and updated capability or limitation statements. For comment-only changes, record how executable tokens and tool directives were preserved.
